items.text: Static CCTV cameras now function correctly after an infinite power bug fix.

Sprinklers now reliably produce splash effects and maintain their fuel type, fixing occasional skips and null‑fuel glitches.
Water guns, pistols and sprinklers now use the proper colored splashes and no longer start with plain water.
Bag markers assigned to you while dead now appear on the map immediately, fixing missing visibility after death.
Fish gutting now has a 20% chance to yield a blueprint fragment instead of cloth.
Underwater crates now contain blueprint fragments and pages, expanding loot options.
Death screen sleeping bag buttons now size correctly, preventing overlap and misclicks.
Dungeon spawn no longer creates a dark square, improving visibility in new areas.
Explosion screen bounce and screenshake now function correctly, restoring intended visual feedback during explosions.

items.text: Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.
Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.
Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.
Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

2026-10-25.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
- Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.

### Farming
- Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
- Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.

### Building & UI
- Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
- Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.

### Bug Fixes
- Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.
